story: ESPN and the NFL list Tampa Bay at Dallas for Thursday 8 October, 8:15 p.m. ET, Prime Video, AT&T Stadium. The Buccaneers are 0-4 and the Cowboys are 2-2. No final is posted. On 4 October the Packers beat Tampa Bay 17-14, a game Baker Mayfield missed with a dislocated thumb. The same day Dallas beat Houston 34-30. CeeDee Lamb caught 17 passes for 189 yards and the 12-yard touchdown with 40 seconds left. Javonte Williams ran for three touchdowns. Three teams are 4-0: Kansas City, Minnesota and San Francisco. The Chiefs are on a bye after a 30-27 win at Las Vegas.
stakes: A fifth loss would leave Tampa Bay alone at the bottom of the NFC South. Dallas can move off 2-2 before Sunday's London game.
